text:
Evelyn: Heads up 11 launching a focused smoke on HS->SF handoff and heartbeat jitter after the round-robin patch. Goal: confirm no duplicate claims and verify heartbeat probe cadence.
Sam: Proposed plan: 300 synthetic leads, eu-west, enrichment sampling 10% to save cost. Validate: 1) single owner claim per lead, 2) heartbeat seen in 30s intervals, 3) sampled leads flagged for QA.
Ravi: Middleware note: X-Redwood-Webhook-Id required for idempotency, dedupe window = 60s in prod. RR fix behind ff: rr-fairness-v1. Rollout: 1% -> 20% -> 100% with auto-rollback on claim.duplicates > 0.
QA-bot: I'll start the run and post summary. Smoke checks: total_sent, sampled_count, dup_claims, p50/p95 handoff latency, heartbeat.missed_count.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: rr-fairness-v1 -> staging (eu-west) at 1755550100. Monitoring enabled.
Sam: Add acceptance criteria: owner.claims.success_rate >= 99.8% and handoff.p95 < 2s. If dup_claims > 0 halt and rollback.
Evelyn: Also test webhook retry behavior: retries at 5s/20s/60s. Ensure idempotency header prevents duplicates.
Ravi: I'll enable verbose logging for the first 2k leads and tag logs with webhook_id and lead_id. QA can pull CSV of sampled leads.
QA-bot: Running canary now. Will report back in ~15m with counts.
Evelyn: Thanks team 1 — proceed, pause at 20% ramp if any anomalies.
